# Designmela

> Creative digital studio building responsive websites, custom web applications, visual brand identities, AI tools, and workflow automations.

Designmela combines thoughtful design with modern engineering to help businesses, startups, and brands launch impactful digital experiences, automate operations, and scale online.

## Main Pages

- [Designmela Homepage](https://designmela.com/): Agency overview, featured work, client portfolio, and interactive consultation chat.
- [Privacy Policy](https://designmela.com/privacy.html): Official privacy policy detailing data collection, chat retention, and visitor rights.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://designmela.com/terms.html): Terms of service governing client project agreements, deposits, and intellectual property.

## Key Sections & Services

- [Services & Capabilities](https://designmela.com/#services): Comprehensive breakdown of web design, web apps, brand identity, AI tools, and business automation.
- [Featured Work](https://designmela.com/#work): Case studies and visual showcases of recent web development, branding, and AI projects.
- [About Designmela](https://designmela.com/#about): Creative studio philosophy, design methodology, and studio background.
- [Project Contact](https://designmela.com/#contact): Project intake form, budget calculator, and direct consultation options.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://designmela.com/#faq): Answers to common questions regarding project timelines, pricing, and deliverables.
